This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER (1) This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973, for grant of bail.

The applicant is facing trial in connection with Crime No.265/2023,
registered at Police Station-Dhamod, District-Dhar for the offence under Sections 366, 376(1),
376(2)(n), 323 and 506 of I.P.C. and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
He is in custody since 26.03.2023 ( 2 ) Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
The applicant is in custody since 26.03.2023.
The FIR was lodged after the delay of one year of the incident.
Age of the prosecutrix is 17 years and 8 months at the time of incident.
Applicant has filed some photographs which shows the consent of the prosecutrix.
Therefore, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: (3) O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
(4) Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the prosecutrix was a consenting party, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
without commenting anything on the merits of the case, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

(5) It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
(6) This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Vikas vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119946203/
